in_marathi.name: Kundana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Having a rounded form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kundana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kundana is a name given to the divine serpent Ananta, who is often depicted as having a thousand hoods. The name Kundana comes from the Sanskrit word 'kundala', meaning 'rounded form'. This powerful deity is believed to represent eternal life, protection, and auspiciousness.
